mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_record (tracking_number, booking_id, cargo_status) VALUES (#{trackingNumber}, #{bookingId}, #{cargoStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE tracking_record SET cargo_status = #{cargoStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_handling_event (tracking_number, event_type, location_unlocode, completion_time, voyage_number) VALUES (#{trackingNumber}, #{eventType}, #{locationUnlocode}, #{completionTime}, #{voyageNumber,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tracking_number, event_type, location_unlocode, completion_time, voyage_number FROM tracking_handling_event WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber} ORDER BY completion_time ASC

SELECT he.id, he.tracking_number, tr.booking_id, he.event_type, he.location_unlocode, he.completion_time FROM tracking_handling_event he JOIN tracking_record tr ON he.tracking_number = tr.tracking_number ORDER BY he.completion_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_exception_event (tracking_number, exception_type, location_unlocode, occurrence_time, reason, response_note, escalation_flag) VALUES (#{trackingNumber}, #{exceptionType}, #{locationUnlocode}, #{occurrenceTime}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{responseNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{escalationFlag})
